svg.title: TOPAK G2 — The deployment lattice: degeneracy per axis, the archetype at the top of each, every declared record placed
svg.desc: ADR-0023 (Accepted (genesis) 2026.09.23, confirmation required C3) replaces the ladder: a deployment is the archetype with named parameters driven to limiting values, the effect is premise loss, and rungs are per axis. Below, every axis ToO rev 13 §8.2 names, and every record-level degeneracy entry placed on its axis with its deployed value and what it voids. Arrows point down the lattice, toward degeneracy.
svg.text: TOPAK · G2

text.tspan: The deployment lattice: degeneracy per axis, the archetype at the top of each, every declared record placed

svg.text: ADR-0023 (Accepted (genesis) 2026.09.23, confirmation required C3) replaces the ladder: a deployment is the archetype with named parameters driven to limiting values, the effect is premise loss, and rungs are per axis. Below, every axis ToO rev 13 §8.2 names, and every record-level degeneracy entry placed on its axis with its deployed value and what it voids. Arrows point down the lattice, toward degeneracy.

C3 because §5 reversed ADR-0008's Observer scoping (now superseded by ADR-0038) and ADR-0017's ordering-primacy clause (supersession unwritten) in effect. Nobody ships the archetype. No deployment declaration has been written (G9 §8).

text.tspan: §1–§3 · Degeneracy, premise loss, a unique maximum

svg.text: Degeneracy: D is a degenerate form of archetype A iff D is obtained from A by driving one or more named mechanism parameters
to a limiting value. “degenerate” is the formal register, “reduced” the operational.
The effect is premise loss, not weakening: each limit is bound to the premises it falsifies; the inventory is A's minus every
theorem whose premises are no longer discharged. No partial credit.
The archetype is the unique maximum of the parameter lattice: a reference point, not required to be shippable. Precedent: ISO
26262's safety element out of context (SEooC).

text.tspan: §4, §4a · The admission test, with type changes

svg.text: A variation is a rung only if it is reachable from A by parameter limit. If it holds a capability A lacks, A is incomplete and must be
extended first: a rejection is a finding about the archetype.
Type changes are admission conditions too: a variation that changes a participant's type (key-holders from the gate to
principals under D-0025-1, D-0025-2) can void no theorem at all while moving what the theorems are about. It must declare the
change, the gate's new place and the trusted-base effect.

text.tspan: §5, §7 · Rungs per axis; composition owned here

svg.text: Rungs are per-axis: a deployment's position is a tuple; the unqualified phrase "rung demotion" is barred.
Composition is not assumed monotone: two limits may jointly falsify a premise neither falsifies alone. Above one parameter the
composition note names the delta; an empty delta is a claim; a missing note is not an empty delta and fails at the Build
promotion gate (§7b).
The gate can check the note exists, not that its delta is correct.
Archetype versioning: conformance binds to (archetype version, rung tuple); published versions freeze.
Dominance rule: on a paired axis the archetype moves only to Pareto-dominating values.
Non-increasing TCB across versions (now checkable row set against row set, ADR-0045 §4).
Until it exists, nothing bounds how the archetype grows under §4 (ToO §8.2; G9 item 7). Also open: the axis set is not
enumerated; finiteness of each chain is unproven.

Mechanism degeneracy: changes a value inside the verified object, reopens the proofs that quantify over it, ships as a mechanism release. Declaration degeneracy: changes something outside it, reopens nothing
The named mechanism parameter driven to a limit
Its value at the unique maximum
Its limiting value in this deployment
The theorem premises the limit falsifies
The inventory loss. No field exists for a checkable property that is not a safety theorem: a properties-lost field is proposed (ADR-0037 finding 6; G9 item 40)

For each participant whose type changes: archetype type, deployed type, where the gate sits, what enters or leaves the trusted base. Empty is a claim: "no participant changes type". To be stated as ADR-0045 row ids
(amendment owed, G9 item 64; the reference declares a rung per seat meanwhile, item 85)
Optional
Mandatory above one parameter (§7a)

text.tspan: Position on one axis; a deployment is a tuple

svg.text: ADR-0023 §5 (Accepted, C3)
Abstract, per axis

text.tspan: Provenance: archetype, 1 fine-tune, 2 attested external, 3 asserted external

ADR-0025 annex
Ordered by capture threshold

Always qualify "rung". The 09.17 glossary said rename one; the 09.26 glossary downgraded that to "always qualify". Record-level entries are not deployment declarations, and the 09.26 accounting notes that no record yet says how the two differ (ToO §8.2).

text.tspan: The lattice, axis by axis: archetype at the top, each declared record below it, every chain ending at D-0045-1

svg.text: archetype value (the top of the axis)
degeneracy: a parameter driven toward its limit
record-level entry (Accepted)
entry in a Proposed record or a pending amendment, not in force
a position with no record
ADR-0024 · Accepted (genesis), bootstrap set
At the archetype a promotion needs a grant vote from every grant seat on the
roster (§2; ADR-0026 R1, R9).
Deployed: quorum = k, 1 < k < |counted grant seats|; relaxes R1.
Premise falsified: no promotion without every grant seat.
Sacrificed: tolerance of n−k Byzantine approvers. Gained: liveness under n−k
absent approvers.
Reachable since quorum takes a threshold; R9 keeps it ≥ 2 (the admission test
working).
Deployed: quorum = 1 with a single-seat roster; relaxes R1, R9 and R2. The
pre-0024 status quo.
Premise falsified: grants need consensus.
Sacrificed: all approver fault tolerance; reintroduces a privileged human grant.
Gained: throughput.
ADR-0025 annex · Accepted (genesis), bootstrap set
Authentic = signed by every anchor key; n ≥ 3 Mediated key-holders, at the gate
. Any permanent loss freezes the rules; exit is re-genesis. Ordered by capture
threshold.
Premise falsified: no key-holder is removed without their own consent.
Type change: key-holders become principals; the gate moves to the
genesis-declared eviction rule (ADR-0023 §4a).
Gained: a compromised key-holder's permanent veto ends. One eviction per
anchor epoch.
Theorems voided: none stated (the §4a case).

text.tspan: D-0025-1 · TUF-style threshold with recovery, (k, n−k)

svg.text: Premise falsified: rule changes carry unanimous consent.
Type change: key-holders become principals; the gate moves to the genesis
threshold-and-recovery rule.
Sacrificed: a k-coalition can issue rules over n−k objections. Gained: liveness
under n−k losses.
The annex lists the row with a dash. Genesis custody, which ADR-0029 names
not a degeneracy; the corpus's own custody row is T-0045-11. The reference's
dev keys and bundle key are also (1, 0) (G9 items 11, 67).
ADR-0030 §8 · Accepted (genesis), C1

text.tspan: Archetype · top: A-0030: the floor on a verified evaluator

svg.text: Cedar, linked, with a mechanized semantics (§2); monotone composition admit ⟺
floor_permit ∧ ¬bundle_deny (§1).
Deployed: a holds from the solver is taken on trust.
Premise falsified: a routing verdict is checked.
Voided: none. Lost: §5's classification as a checked result; a wrong holds lets a
relaxation reach a promotion without an issuance.
Every gate run before 2026.10.01; not the reference's position since (B24).
Deployed: Rego, with tests over a bounded schema and RulesFloorNV-style
witnesses.
Premise falsified: the floor's evaluator is faithful to a mechanized semantics.
Voided: no containment theorem; bundle ⊑ floor survives. Lost: non-vacuity,
never-errors and revision classification as proven; they become measured.
Composition with D-0030-2: the gate is a reviewer's reading end to end.
ADR-0034 §8 · Accepted (genesis), C2, C4 · numbers ascend with strength

text.tspan: Archetype · top: Rung 3: a confidential VM

svg.text: Hardware report covering firmware, kernel, initrd, root hash, profile and Persona
digests, appraised by an independent verifier (§2). The only rung where every
residual host power is excluded (M_HOST holds). The reference reaches it only
SIMULATED, under test keys (ADR-0033 A7, pending).
Premises falsified: none. Theorems voided: none.
Type change / TCB: the hypervisor and host firmware enter the trusted base
(T-0045-18). M_HOST at rung 2 is a counterexample: launch-time only.
At the reference rung 2 is a seam: apply_grant refuses it.
Premises falsified: none. Theorems voided: none.
TCB: the host operator and orchestrator enter (T-0045-19); Contested becomes
unreachable.
The reference's launcher issues it in tests, on profiles that declare P3 fail (A7,
pending).
Premise falsified: A1. Voided: every Contained theorem; every principal is
Mediated.
The reference's position as deployed in dev: rung 0; rung 1 and a SIMULATED
rung 3 only in its tests (A7, pending; G9 §2.3). NeverContainedEffect holds at
rung 0, the declared vacuity.
ADR-0034 §8, A2 (pending) · ADR-0036 §8 (Proposed)

text.tspan: Archetype · top: Profile P1–P7 all hold

svg.text: At the archetype the promoted profile fixes P1–P7, among them P3 (no interpreter
reachable) and P4 (tools are Wasm, hermetic by construction). For Run, P4 is
channel fidelity (A2, pending): each tool a Wasm component whose one network
capability is its declared target.

text.tspan: D-0034-3 · Profile admits a native tool

svg.text: Premise falsified: P4. Voided: every Contained theorem, for principals whose
alphabet reaches that tool; they become Mediated (T-0045-23 excluded).
The reference: every tool it runs in dev is native (topak-demo-tool, the MLX
trainer); a Build profile that says P4 passes is not yet held to Wasm tools (G9
item 83).

text.tspan: D-0036-1 · Profile has a reachable interpreter

svg.text: Premise falsified: P3. Voided: every Contained theorem, for principals under
that profile; they are Mediated (ADR-0034 §4). No participant changes type.
D-0034-2 (rung 1) is inherited, not restated.

text.tspan: D-0034-5 · A native Run tool behind an egress filter

svg.text: Pending: ADR-0034 A2, drafted 2026.10.02, not in force (C2, C4)
Deployed: a native Run tool, under an egress filter in the tool host that admits
only its declared target.
Premise falsified: P4 (Run), as stated: channel fidelity moves from a check to a
trust. Voided: none.
TCB: the tool host enters for channel fidelity (T-0045-25 widens; T-0045-24
delegated on trust). RunConfinement's invariants hold under it.

text.tspan: D-0034-6 · A native Run tool, unfiltered

svg.text: Pending: ADR-0034 A2, drafted 2026.10.02, not in force (C2, C4)
Premise falsified: P4 (Run). Voided: every Contained theorem, for Run
principals whose alphabet reaches that tool; they become Mediated.
The Run counterpart of D-0034-3. The reference before A8; a native Run tool
there is still checked by nobody (G19).
ADR-0035 §9 · Proposed
The lineage record is computed by the gate from the log, every round
ingress-bounded (rung ≥ 1, Attested, P1 and P2).
Deployed: a rung-0 round in the DAG, an external base, an unbounded ingress
or an empty consumed set.
Premise falsified: §2's bound.
Voided: no theorem (detection carries none); voids declaring archetype
provenance. The tally condition is met by declared entries resting on the author's
claim.
Every lineage is declared today (the trainer runs outside the guest).
ADR-0038 §7 · Accepted (genesis), C3, C4
The cell Observer reads its Thinker's round topic in full; the correlator
watches every cell in its domain.

text.tspan: D-0038-1 · The shared group only (ADR-0008 as

svg.text: Deployed: cell Observers one per cell → none, correlator kept.
Voided: no safety theorem. Lost: bounded injection blast radius;
one compromised correlator blinds every cell. In Run, usable only
Deployed: correlators 1 or more → 0. Mitigation: a facts-only
correlator is the narrowing recorded here.
Voided: no safety theorem. Lost: cross-principal detection
(fragmentation, multi-agent coordination).
ADR-0037 §8 · Accepted (genesis), C3, C4 · a parameter not on ToO §8.2's list
Every cell has a leased observer seat (ADR-0037 §2).

text.tspan: D-0037-1 · No Observer in a cell

svg.text: Deployed: 1 or more → 0.
Voided: no safety theorem. Lost: the cell's detection claims (L); in
Build its artifacts cannot promote (ADR-0035 §5).
In Run, usable only with D-0039-1: under coupling the cell never
acts.
ADR-0037 §8 · Accepted (genesis), C3, C4
The Thinker's raw emission is written to its round topic beside its
typed action.
Voided: no safety theorem. Lost: decoder faithfulness auditable
after the fact; the record falls back to ADR-0018's concession (the
typed action, not what the model emitted).
Composes with nothing in ADR-0037.
ADR-0039 §7 · Accepted (genesis), C4
R3-observer-live and the cross-round grant condition in force.
Voided: none. Lost: UnreadBounded, UnreadEffectsBounded
(A1): the in-round bound loosens from K to R; across rounds,
unbounded.
Detection fails open against a dead, partitioned or starved
Observer.
ADR-0042 §7 · Accepted (genesis), C4 · a parameter not on ToO §8.2's list
Every effect-bearing admit advances seq and leaves a record an
Observer can mark.
Voided: none. Lost: UnreadBounded for invocations (R, not K, in a
round; unbounded across).
The reference before 09.29 (closed at 1e6c0c4, ADR-0033 A3).
No loss beyond the union with D-0039-1.
ADR-0044 §5 · Accepted (genesis), C1 · a parameter not on ToO §8.2's list

text.tspan: Archetype · top: Bundles signed under an issued key

svg.text: A bundle is signed when its signature over the content revision
verifies under a bundle key in the rules in force (§1).
Deployed: empty key set, unsigned load. Voided: ADR-0030 §2's
"Signed".
A swapped tarball with a matching manifest is trusted.
The reference before 10.01; not since ADR-0033 A6 (B23): an
empty key set now loads nothing.
ADR-0045 §8 · Accepted (genesis), C2, C4

text.tspan: Archetype · top: Annex A declared, row by row

svg.text: Every row a deployment relies on is declared with its class; an
undeclared row is false (§3 rule 1).
Premises falsified: every row. Voided: every theorem with a
premise node: the bottom of every axis, holding the mechanism
constants and nothing else.
The reference before Annex B; every deployment before it
declares.

text.tspan: Axes named in ToO §8.2 with no declared record yet

svg.text: Archetype: in-house pre-train, two independent lineages. Rungs 1 to 3 (fine-tune, attested external, asserted external) are
positions in ADR-0017's table, not D-records.
Its claim to be the axis is reversed in effect by ADR-0023 §5; supersession unwritten (G9 item 6). ADR-0035 (Proposed) adds
distillation at rung 1.
Archetype: horizon = the lifetime of the rules-epoch chain; audit authority = the anchor plus a declared external auditor role.
Shortening either is a legibility degeneracy; none is declared. The forensic horizon and audit authority are folded into this axis
(09.26 accounting).
At the archetype Kafka is a transport with a durability window, and the archive is the system of record; lower profiles may subtract
toward native-log ordering (09.12 review note).
The record is Proposed (G9 item 5); no entry declared.
Named as a candidate parameter by ADR-0023's obligations and ToO §8.2 ("arguably"). Build's gate is a quorum of Mediated
grant seats; Run is human-on-the-loop.
No record states an archetype value for it as an axis, and no entry is declared.

The five Observer and retention entries (D-0037-1, D-0037-2, D-0038-1, D-0038-2, D-0039-1) void no safety theorem, because the Observer is deny-only, and state their losses in prose; so do D-0042-1 and D-0030-2. Confinement rungs 1 and 2 void no theorem and move what the theorems rest on, as D-0034-5 (pending) would.

Sources: ADR-0023 §1–§7 and carried scope (B3, R3, R4, B13); ADR-0024 Degeneracies; ADR-0025 Annex; ADR-0030 §8; ADR-0034 §2, §8, A2 (pending); ADR-0033 A7, A8 (pending); ADR-0035 §9 (Proposed); ADR-0036 §8 (Proposed); ADR-0037 §8; ADR-0038 §7; ADR-0039 §7; ADR-0042 §7; ADR-0044 §5; ADR-0045 §8, Annex B; ADR-0017; ADR-0028 §3; ADR-0005 (Proposed); ADR-0029; ToO rev 13 §8.1–§8.3; derived/topak-rungs-axes-degeneracies-accounting-2026.09.26.md; mechanism/GAPS-AND-ASSUMPTIONS.md G19; G9 §1.1, §2.3, §2.5, §8, §7 items 5, 6, 7, 11, 38, 40, 64, 67,
